### P10 "Depth of Field" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Depth-of-field with bokeh-biased sampling. Bright pixels contribute more strongly, letting highlights form the characteristic disc / hexagonal bokeh. `bokehShape` selects the sample pattern. Single-pass scatter-as-gather: every tap is weighted by whether ITS OWN circle of confusion reaches this pixel, so a sharp subject does not bleed into the blurred background and a blurred foreground does spil…; categories: Post-process, Focus; inputs: inputImage:image, camera:uniform, focusDepth:float=8, focusRange:float=1.5, blurAmount:float=16, bokehShape:long=0, highlightBias:float=1.5

68 lines, not listed: the process was created from the library file `<LIBRARY>:packages/score-csf-testers/shaderlib/depth/Depth Bokeh DoF.fs`.

### P13 "Depth Micro AO" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Fast single-pass ambient occlusion. Samples eight neighbours at a user radius, counts how many rise more than `bias` above the tangent plane of the current pixel (normal-oriented hemisphere, with a range check), and darkens proportionally. Not as clean as GTAO (see the Multi-pass wave) but cheap, punchy, and single-pass.; categories: Post-process, Lighting; inputs: inputImage:image, camera:uniform, radius:float=8, bias:float=0.01, intensity:float=1.2

59 lines, not listed: the process was created from the library file `<LIBRARY>:packages/score-csf-testers/shaderlib/depth/Depth Micro AO.fs`.
